Backend smoke_marketplace.py PASSED (fees, packaging items+configs+assign, order preview/save formulas, single-point stock deduction on status transitions, duplicate order_id blocked, CSV+XLSX import wizard preview→validate→commit KPIs valid/dup/error, settlement with cash-in, reconciliation Matched, dashboard, reports). issues: Recharts warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' repeated ~12x in console when the dashboard first renders before ResizeObserver kicks in. Chart still renders correctly after resize, but the warnings are console noise. Consider setting min-w/min-h on chart containers or lazy-mounting after layout settles.

MarketplaceDashboard: recharts responsive containers log width(-1) warnings on first paint — cosmetic but noisy; add minWidth/minHeight or an initial-hidden guard.
